import math

print(f"Ratio: {ratio}")

# Calculate natural logarithm
ln_ratio = math.log(ratio)
print(f"Natural logarithm: {ln_ratio}")

# Round to nearest thousandths place
rounded = round(ln_ratio, 3)
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {rounded}")
